role: CI gate: every regex in Tools/copy_linter/prohibited_terms.json user_facing_prohibited must be matched by some alternative from MedicalTermLexicon*.swift latin:/unbounded: arrays.
toplevel: cd to repo root. CONFIG missing -> 2; no lexicon file -> 2. Python: parse JSON (error -> 2); bracket-walk latin:/unbounded: arrays; unescape; latin wrapped in \b(?:...)\b; compile errors or empty-matching alternatives -> 2; fewer than 100 alternatives -> 2. For each build-time pattern synthesise a probe via probe_for (empty probe -> skipped); probe not matching its own pattern -> 2; probe matched by no lexicon alternative -> missing -> exit 1. Else clean.

flags.text: Header says none of the three lists may grow past the others, but only user_facing_prohibited -> lexicon is checked; coach_response_prohibited and lexicon -> build-time are not. A pattern whose synthesised probe is empty is skipped silently (`if not probe: continue`).

probe_for reduces each alternation to its first branch ((a|b) -> a), so only one spelling per build-time pattern is checked against the lexicon. Spellings that prohibited_terms.json forbids are currently matched by no lexicon alternative while the gate prints 'Every build-time prohibited term is also matched': 'undiagnosed' (:42), 'curing' and 'curative' (:50), 'pathological'/'pathologically' (:70), 'ischaemic' (:110). Verified by running the gate's own extracted alternatives against those words.
